FRAME bundled phonemizer notice (2026-10-09)

The npm package @diffusionstudio/piper-wasm@1.0.0 labels its packaging MIT.
Its compiled phonemizer includes eSpeak NG, which is GPL-3.0.
The package label does not override eSpeak NG's license.
The full GPL text is piper-wasm-GPL.txt. Source archives and upstream build
instructions are included here; sources-manifest.json records download URL,
bytes and SHA-256. Preserve these notices when redistributing this component.

The source for the Piper phonemizer is wide-video/piper-phonemize.
The upstream CMake fixes eSpeak NG to commit
0f65aa301e0d6bae5e172cc74197d32a6182200f, whose complete source archive is included.
The original npm build README is retained. The npm binary was downloaded rather
than locally rebuilt; FRAME does not claim a byte-identical reproducible rebuild
or invent an unknown exact release-time source commit for that npm binary.

Other runtime packages retain their package metadata and license records.
Piper voice model/data terms are separate: see each .MODEL_CARD and STORY_MODELS.md.
